models.name: Speaker Helicopter (Supply)
models.notes: Supply helicopter, Speakerman version: troop cabin with the side door open, big speaker boxes on top. Built from the Camera Helicopter by KonoDioDaD and the Speaker Helicopter by MrDreivar (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0).

models.name: TV Helicopter (Supply)
models.notes: Supply helicopter, TV Man version: troop cabin with the side door open and a big TV with a glowing blue screen on the nose. Built from the Camera Helicopter by KonoDioDaD (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0).

models.name: Monitor Man Armored
models.by: Built by Fo from Monitor_man101's design
models.notes: The [REWORK] armored version: black armor over a long coat, green-edged shoulder spikes, a glowing green chest core in a ring, CRT monitor head with the green code screen, sunglasses and headphones.

models.name: Monitor Man
models.by: Built by Fo from Monitor_man101's design
models.notes: Black-clad humanoid with a CRT monitor head showing green code rain, sunglasses and headphones, from the [Monitor-man 1.5] TikTok reference.

models.name: Strider TV
models.by: AGI (aka A Goofy Idiot), Sketchfab (CC BY 4.0)
models.notes: Fan-made three-legged TV strider with full textures, converted from Sketchfab and lightly reduced for the web. In the game repo as StriderTV.obj.

models.name: TV Man
models.notes: Game-ready textured TV Man humanoid. In the game repo as TVMan.fbx.

models.name: Red Titan
models.notes: v2: Dark speaker-head Titan in a long black coat, with a glowing red sword, two Titan Speakerman blasters, a jetpack with glowing thrusters and a big red shield disc on his back. 43 separate parts you can pose. Design inspired by @upgraded_titan_drillman0 (TikTok). Blasters: "Titan Speakerman's New Blaster" by ~Drift~ (QuickDriftVR, Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0).

models.name: Scientist MK2
models.notes: Upgraded unit (MK2). Heavy dark exo-armor over a long coat, gas-mask helmet with a glowing yellow visor, two forearm energy blades and two yellow energy halo rings on his back. Smooth separate parts you can pose, playable in the game.

models.name: Engineer MK2
models.notes: Upgraded unit (MK2). Heavy dark exo-armor over a long coat, masked face with glowing yellow goggles, a huge right arm cannon with glowing rings and a short energy blade on the left arm. Smooth separate parts you can pose, playable in the game.

models.name: Spider Rig MK2
models.notes: Upgraded unit (MK2). Armored pilot in black sunglasses riding a rounded pod on six long spider legs with glowing yellow joints. Energy blade on the left arm, gatling arm cannon on the right. Smooth separate parts you can pose, playable in the game.

models.name: Titan Cameraman 1.0
models.notes: Titan Cameraman 1.0 with a glowing blue core, blue camera lenses and a shield with a blue eye. Model by Count!?dow! (YouTube 'Big pack'), assets by @Gabs92FG67, @IlhmDoodles, @AbytronGC_P3D and Sketchfab artists. Playable in the game (Titans > Fan-Made Titans).
